name: Effective Sigil Work

phase_0.boundary_condition: The closed loop of the ritual space and the completed glyph

VINIT.justification: The blank state before any intention is formed or encoded

TANCH.justification: The closed container that isolates the operation from the profane environment

AFWD.justification: The forward projection of the charged symbol into the causal field

AREV.justification: The reverse movement of the intent from the conscious mind into the deep psyche

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of design, charge, and release protocols

IMSCRIB.justification: The sigil as a mirror of the operator's own deep desire

FSPLIT.justification: Splits the unified intent into the active conscious charge and the passive subconscious receptacle

FFUSE.justification: Reunites the active charge and subconscious drive to manifest the original intent in reality

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where the sigil successfully locks onto the target probability

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the operator fails to detach, causing the charge to collapse

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice of holding the intent in the subconscious while simultaneously erasing it from the conscious mind

IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of the manifested effect into the material timeline

phase_3.void_description: Uncharged parchment, pre-intentional void before any encoding
phase_3.true_description: Synchronized charge, active broadcast propagation locked to target
phase_3.false_description: Dissipated charge, failure to detach from the conscious mind
phase_3.both_description: The liminal state of forgetting, holding the intent in the subconscious while erasing it from conscious awareness

steps.domain_action: Establish the uncharged void and blank state before intent is formed
Recognize the operator's true deep desire through self-reference
Compose the symbolic encoding by translating the intent into a glyph
Bifurcate the conscious mind into the active charge and the passive subconscious
Project the active charge forward through broadcast propagation
Affirm the successful synchronization of the charge with the target probability
Descend the intent into the subconscious through deliberate forgetting
Register the failure state if the charge dissipates or detachment fails
Reconstitute the active charge and subconscious drive into manifested reality
Hold the paradice of the liminal state where intent is both subconscious and conscious-absent
Seal the terminal boundary of the completed ritual space
Fix the irreversible causal imprint of the manifestation into the material timeline

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The symbolic encoding algorithm translating words to geometric glyphs
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Resonant frequency coupling the glyph to the subconscious drive
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The causal imprint of the activated sigil in the probability field
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Planetary hours, lunar phases, and the operator's gnosis threshold
phase_5.alfs_store: The foundational geometric lattice and Ur-sigil of the tradition

phase_6.cycle_cost: The operator's focused attention and emotional energy
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Uncharged symbol with high potential energy and zero kinetic manifestation
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Manifested effect with depleted operator and collapsed probability wave
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy expended in charging is exactly conserved in the causal rearrangement of the manifestation
